faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Risk Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Chief Risk Officer position is 12 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Chief Risk Officer post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Chief Risk Officer position is 40 years. Candidates must meet this age criterion as of 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief Risk Officer post is 55 years. This age limit is applicable as of 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for the Chief Risk Officer role?
faq.answer: Essential qualifications include a Graduate Degree and a Professional certification in financial risk management from GARP or PRMIA, or at least two years of experience as CRO in a regulated lending entity.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any desirable qualifications for the Chief Risk Officer position?
faq.answer: Yes, desirable qualifications include CFA, CA, CMA, or a Postgraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Banking, or Risk Management.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Risk Officer post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Chief Risk Officer position in Punjab & Sind Bank.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 1180/-. This fee is payable online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC and ST candidates is also Rs. 1180/-. Payment should be made through the online mode.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary scrutiny, shortlisting, personal interaction/interview, assessment of knowledge and leadership abilities, credential verification, and final selection based on interview merit.

faq.question: Q10. In which mode can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the Chief Risk Officer position through the online mode only. The application window is from 03 September 2026 to 12 September 2026.
